name: PokemonFusedDimensions Port
author: gba_world pipeline
description: Automated world port of Pokemon Fused Dimensions (v2.3).gba (425 maps, 60 tileset pairs) into the Multiverse Hub. Loads pre-baked Marshal .rxdata maps directly (ids fixed at emit time, no runtime remap) and registers them through MultiverseHub's GAUNTLET_MAP_BUILDERS / load_data hooks. Geometry + tilesets + warps + transpiled NPC/coord/sign scripts, plus a data layer (data_layer.rb) that additively registers the species / moves / abilities / wild encounters / trainers decoded from the ROM into GameData at load time -- no PBS file is touched, overlapping species reuse the existing entry.
